PeekaPeeka

Tiny companions for Safari.

Coming soon to the App Store.

A little hello, from the edge.

Choose from 150 pixel companions in six collections of 25: cats, dogs, robots, dragons, friendly monsters, and other pets. Their heads peek from the edge of Safari webpages, then slip away. Tap a visitor to dismiss it for the current page.

One companion in every collection is free. Optional one-time collection purchases unlock the other 24 companions. No subscription.
